title: Surface Area of 3D Shapes
description:
You are given an n x n grid where you have placed some 1 x 1 x 1 cubes. Each value v = grid[i][j] represents a tower of v cubes placed on top of cell (i, j) . 
 
 After placing these cubes, you have decided to glue any directly adjacent cubes to each other, forming several irregular 3D shapes. 
 
 Return the total surface area of the resulting shapes . 
 
 Note: The bottom face of each shape counts toward its surface area. 

 Example 1: 
 [Figure: https://assets.leetcode.com/uploads/2021/01/08/tmp-grid2.jpg] 
 
```
Input:
 grid = [[1,2],[3,4]]

Output:
 34
```

 Example 2: 
 [Figure: https://assets.leetcode.com/uploads/2021/01/08/tmp-grid4.jpg] 
 
```
Input:
 grid = [[1,1,1],[1,0,1],[1,1,1]]

Output:
 32
```

 Example 3: 
 [Figure: https://assets.leetcode.com/uploads/2021/01/08/tmp-grid5.jpg] 
 
```
Input:
 grid = [[2,2,2],[2,1,2],[2,2,2]]

Output:
 46
```

 Constraints: 

 n == grid.length == grid[i].length 
 
 1 <= n <= 50 
 
 0 <= grid[i][j] <= 50
approach_summary: Exploit arithmetic invariants, divisibility, or combinatorial counting.
